items.title: Apps for women make more $$$
items.summary:
Good morning.
Back to school, back to the grind.
That September reset does something to our minds called
the fresh start effect
(same effect as a new years resolution).
Summer is over and people are locked in. I can fell it.
If you have been building, now is the time to sell.
Companies spend $$$ in September-December to use up all their budget before the end of the quarter.
Estimated reading time: 2 minutes 39 seconds

items.title: Your very own international school
items.summary:
Why now
YouTube now offers automatic
dubbing
in 27 languages.
Creators who dub their videos get
25%+
of their watch time from viewers in other languages.
Now imagine taking all the stuff we learn online in English and producing it for the world.
...like this newsletter for instance!

items.title: Create some leverage for yourself
items.summary:
Good morning.
Happy
Labor
Leverage day!
It's the best time to use tools, tech and the internet to create leverage for yourself.
I think about the eras of building startups over the last 15 years.
2012:
you needed an army of devs and capital in silicon valley
2020:
duct-tape no code tools, databases, automation workflows
2027:
AI, an idea, focus and the courage to sell.
Today's ideas presented by Google AI Studio
They just released Lyria 3.5, which lets you make expressive vocals directly in AI Studio, so you can build music into your apps and give them a whole new life.

items.title: Turn instruments into plugins that sell
items.summary:
Why now
I found this who recorded his
antique harmonium
.
9,000 people downloaded it.. for free.. which is fine but we build businesses around here.
Producers are looking for more finished instrument recordings instead of the tech synth stuff.
Just ask Tyler the Creator.
Antique Harmonium plug-in. Source:
Pianobook
.
The idea
Find niche instruments played by world class musicians.
Get them to record the instrument across its full range into pack of notes.
Make a plugin, give the musician a royalty...

items.title: Sell the thing, get rich off refills
items.summary:
Dyson is launching a
$499 toothbrush with a camera inside it
.
Toothpaste foam blocks the camera, so Dyson made a foam-free toothpaste...
sounds like stuff you'd use in space.
So if you're brushing regularly you need their paste every month.
Dyson CameraJet. Source:
vittorio on X
.
A few more examples:
SharkNinja put out a
$200 countertop water filter
. The screen turns red when the filter dies, and a QR code on the machine reorders a $40 replacement.
When Traeger Grill sales
dropped
last year, pellets, rubs, and sauces grew to a quarter of their total revenue.
Traeger pellet flavors.
